item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7 #SLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 05:00 PM 18 August 2026

Orange Warning: #OrientalMindoro
Associated Hazard: FLOODING is still threatening in low lying areas and near river channels. LANDSLIDES are threatening in landslide prone areas.

Meanwhile, Moderate to heavy rains are expected over #Albay(Libon, Bacacay, Malilipot, CityOfTabaco, SantoDomingo, Malinao, RapuRapu, CityOfLigao, Oas, PioDuran, Guinobatan, Camalig, Daraga, LegazpiCity, Jovellar, Manito), #Catanduanes(SanMiguel, Baras, Bato, Virac), #Romblon(Calatrava, SanAndres, SanAgustin, Odiongan, SantaMaria, Ferrol, Looc, Alcantara, SantaFe, Romblon), #NorthernSamar(SilvinoLobos, LasNavas, Catubig, LopeDeVega), #Sorsogon(Matnog, Bulan, Irosin, Juban, Magallanes, Casiguran, Donsol, Pilar, Castilla, CityOfSorsogon), #CamarinesNorte(SantaElena, Capalonga, JosePanganiban, Labo), #Masbate(Aroroy, Baleno, Balud, Batuan, Cataingan, Cawayan, Dimasalang, Esperanza, Mandaon, CityOfMasbate, Milagros, Mobo, Monreal, Palanas, PioV.Corpuz, Placer, SanFernando, SanJacinto and Uson) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Marinduque, #CamarinesSur(Magarao, Calabanga, Bombon, NagaCity, Canaman, Milaor, Gainza, Pili, Tinambac, Goa, Lagonoy, Siruma, Ocampo, Tigaon, Sagñay, Baao, IrigaCity, Bula, Nabua, Buhi, Cabusao, Libmanan, Pamplona, Pasacao, SanFernando, Minalabac, Balatan, Bato, SanJose, Presentacion, Garchitorena, Caramoan, DelGallego, Ragay, Lupi, Sipocot), #Albay(Polangui, Tiwi), #Catanduanes(Pandan, SanAndres, Caramoran, Bagamanoc, Panganiban, Viga, Gigmoto), #Romblon(Concepcion, Banton, Corcuera, Magdiwang, SanFernando, Cajidiocan), #Sorsogon(Bulusan, Barcelona, Gubat, PrietoDiaz, SantaMagdalena), #CamarinesNorte(Vinzons, Talisay, Daet, Basud, Mercedes, SanLorenzoRuiz, SanVicente, Paracale), #Masbate(Claveria and SanPascual) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 08:00 PM Today.
